note: Shared Resource Spine — numeric taxonomy + rules for declaring shared resources. Business logic references resources through ResourceRef/ResourceBinding/DataResourceSpec, never raw table/bucket/path names or raw keys. Runtime branches on these NUMERIC codes, never display strings. SINGLE SOURCE for src/teleon/resources/resource_ref.py.

ownership_modes.label: external_existing
ownership_modes.desc: Pre-existing resource we only reference (never create/destroy).

ownership_modes.label: managed_ephemeral
ownership_modes.desc: We own a short-lived resource that must be cleaned up.

ownership_modes.label: pipeline_temp
ownership_modes.desc: Scratch resource for one pipeline run; auto-expire.

ownership_modes.label: tenant_dedicated
ownership_modes.desc: Persistent resource isolated to a tenant.

rules.cloud_requires_local_equivalent: provider != 'local' requires local_equivalent (offline golden path) or ProviderUnavailableResult
rules.logical_name_required: every spec/ref carries a logical_name; physical handle lives in the ResourceBinding
